team.title: Your team
approvals.title: To approve
approvals.empty.title: All caught up
approvals.empty.text: When an agent finishes a job, it shows up here for you to review.
approvals.after: Approving adds the work to the project. Rejecting discards it.
job.title: What should the office do?
job.sub: Describe it in a few words. The agent decides how.
job.placeholder: E.g.: organize the documents for the Doe case (fictional data)
job.sent: Sent! An agent is on it.
job.safety: Use fictional data when testing. Nothing leaves the office without your approval.
settings.tokenfail: Could not find the key. Is Docker running?
error.offline: Cannot reach the office at {url}. Is Docker running?
error.auth: Missing or invalid access key. Open Settings and tap Fetch key.
settings.heightHint: The taskbar height is detected automatically. Only use this to correct it.
settings.trayhint: The characters disappear, but the icon stays in the Windows tray (near the clock). Click it to come back. If you don't see it, check the ^ arrow.
team.intro: Create specialists to split the work. The chief takes the requests and hands each part to the right specialist.
edit.name: Name
edit.instrhint: Explain the task and the way of working. The clearer, the better the result.
edit.chiefhint: Optional: general guidance from the chief (office style, priorities).
team.pack.title: Ready-made pack: social-security law office
team.pack.text: 5 orchestrators and 16 pre-configured specialists organized in teams (benefits, litigation and deadlines, documents and drafting, clients and schedule, management), with the safety rules. You can edit each one afterwards.
edit.kindhint: Orchestrators coordinate a team and always stand on the bar. Specialists only show up when they are called.
edit.pinnedhint: By default a specialist only shows up while working.
chat.empty: Say hello! You can ask a question or request a job.
chat.waiting: A job is waiting for your approval.
chat.chiefhint: Not sure who to talk to? Write here: {name} sends it to whoever knows.
chat.hello.chief: Hi! I'm {name}. Tell me what you need and I'll hand it to the right person on the team.
chat.hello: Hi! I'm {name} ({role}). How can I help?
settings.hotkey: Shortcut to talk to the chief from anywhere: Ctrl + Alt + E.
review.binary: This file is not text: it will be in the deliveries folder once approved.
review.truncated: Large file: showing only the beginning.
approvals.saved: Approved! A copy was saved to your Documents > Escritório Digital folder.
settings.exportshint: Everything you approve is also copied to this folder on your computer (Documents > Escritório Digital).
settings.notify: Windows notifications when something needs you
plan.title: Plan
plan.started: In progress. Follow it in the strip below.
onb.1.title: Meet your team
onb.1.text: The characters on the taskbar are your office. The chief and the leads are always there. Specialists show up when they are called.
onb.2.title: Just ask
onb.2.text: Open the chat and say what you need, the way you would to a person. The chief hands it to whoever knows and shows the plan before starting.
onb.2.me: Analyze Maria's case and draft the request.
onb.2.them: I'll call Helena and Bruno. Shall I start?
onb.3.title: You decide everything
onb.3.text: Nothing leaves the office without your OK. When a job is ready, the character calls you: read the draft, approve or reject.
help.title: What the characters mean
help.working: At a desk: working on a request
help.alert: Red bubble: finished and waiting for your OK
help.badge: Gold badge: the chief. Blue: team lead
help.click: Click any character to chat with them. If you don't know who to talk to, talk to the chief.
conn.title: Google Drive, Gmail and other connectors
conn.text: If you already connected services to your Claude account, the team can look things up in them. For safety everything starts off and, once let in, it is read-only.
conn.s1: Tap “Open Claude connectors”. The Claude site opens in your browser: sign in with the same account the office uses.
conn.s2: Pick the service (for example, Google Drive) and click Connect. Authorize access in the Google window.
conn.s3: Come back here and tap “Refresh list”. Turn on the “Let the team use it” switch for that connector. The team can only read, never change or send.
conn.s4: To turn it off, untick the switch here. To remove access for good, disconnect the service on the Claude site.
conn.empty: No connectors found on your account yet. Follow the steps below to connect the first one.
conn.privacy: What the team reads is processed by Claude. With real client data, use with care and with their consent.
conn.error: I couldn't check the connectors right now. Try again in a moment.
prog.title: Progress of the jobs
prog.empty.title: Nothing in progress
prog.empty.text: When the team is working on a request, you follow everything here, step by step.
pace.title: Why are some waiting?
pace.week: So it doesn't burn your Claude plan all at once, the office is running {workers} of {max} jobs at a time. You have used {used}% of the week and the pace so far is {allowed}%. You can speed it up under Speed, below.
pace.five: Your plan's 5-hour limit is at {used}% (ceiling {allowed}%). Jobs wait for the window to free up.
pace.stopped: The office paused to protect your Claude plan. It resumes by itself when the limit frees up.
pace.other: The office is running {workers} of {max} jobs at a time to look after your Claude plan.
speed.title: Office speed
speed.text: How many jobs may run at the same time. Faster uses your Claude plan sooner. The 80% weekly ceiling still applies.
speed.balanced.hint: Spreads plan usage across the week. If you are already ahead of the pace, it runs 1 job at a time.
speed.fast.hint: Up to 2 jobs in parallel, even when ahead of the weekly pace.
speed.max.hint: All in parallel (up to 3). No pacing: it only stops at the 80% weekly ceiling or 85% of the 5 hours. Uses the plan much faster.
reader.unsaved: You have unsaved changes: save or undo them before continuing.
reader.dismissfirst: Apply or dismiss the proposal before editing.
reader.approve.blocked: Save or undo the document's changes before approving.
reader.ask.ph: E.g.: shorten the second paragraph and mention the deadline
reader.nochange: The proposal changes nothing in this document.
export.made: Also made {n} file(s) in the chosen formats
export.set.title: Other formats on approval.
export.set.text: Besides the original file, the office makes these in your folder ([CONFERIR] passages are highlighted in yellow):
backup.title: Team backup
backup.text: Keep your team (names, instructions, looks) and the speed in a file. If you change computers or something goes wrong, restore it here. It does not include your login or the connector permissions.
backup.restored: Team restored ({n} people). The previous one is kept inside the office.
backup.toolarge: That file is too large to be a team backup.
backup.notjson: That file is not a valid backup.
backup.confirm.title: Restore the team
backup.confirm.msg: Replace the current team with this one, with {n} people?
backup.confirm.detail: The current team is kept inside the office (the last 10 copies). Only restore files you saved yourself or trust: the team's instructions tell the agents what to do.
update.banner: A new version of Digital Office is available: {v}.
update.running: Updating… the characters close and reopen in a moment.
update.failed.title: Update
update.failed: Could not update. Nothing was changed.
update.nonode: Node was not found on this computer. I opened the page of the new version. Tip: ask Claude "Update Digital Office".
update.uptodate: You already have the newest version.
update.auto: Tell me when a new version is out
update.privacy: The check goes only to GitHub (the public page of the releases) and sends nothing of yours. Updating keeps your login, your jobs and your team.
alert.login: The Claude account signed out of the office, so nobody can work. Only you can sign in again.
alert.login.title: Sign in to Claude again
alert.login.s1: Open a terminal (Windows: Start menu, type "Terminal"; Mac: the Terminal app).
alert.login.s2: Paste the command below and press Enter.
alert.login.s3: An address appears: open it in the browser, approve, and paste the code back in the terminal.
alert.login.s4: Done: this notice goes away by itself in a few seconds.
alert.limit: Your Claude plan reached its usage limit. The office waits and resumes by itself when the limit resets; nothing is lost.
legal.title: Before you start: who is responsible for what
legal.p1: Digital Office only makes it easier to install and use Claude. Claude and all rights in it belong to Anthropic; there is no exclusive or commercial use of it here, and each person signs in with their own account.
legal.p2: Everything the agents produce is a draft. Checking, correcting and deciding what to use is the responsibility of you, the user.
legal.p3: Confidentiality, data-protection law and the use of client data are your decision and your responsibility. In tests, use fictitious data only.
legal.p4: The software is provided as is, without warranty of any kind.
rh.title: HR: build and look after your team
rh.text: Tell HR what your office does and it proposes who to hire, changes the instructions of the people you have, and lets go of those no longer needed. You approve every change before it takes effect.
rh.first: Hi! I want to build the team for my office.
rh.firstrun.title: Start by building your team
rh.firstrun.text: For now only the chief and HR are here. HR asks a few questions about your office and proposes the first team for you to approve.
rh.import.title: Import a prompt or a skill
rh.import.text: Already have a prompt or a skill that works well? Paste the text or choose the file: HR adapts it to the office and proposes the employee, who only joins with your OK. Import only material you have the right to use.
rh.import.paste: Paste the text of the prompt or skill here
rh.import.sent: Sent. HR is reading it; the proposal shows up here shortly.
rh.import.big: File too large (the limit is 60,000 characters).
rh.prop.title: HR's proposal
rh.prop.warn: Read the instructions before approving: it is what each person will follow. Untick what you do not want.
